meta.description: Bends paths under the influence of forces. The base of every path stays where it is and the paths keep their length. Branches follow the stem they grow on, so a bent structure still touches.

force.description: The forces that act on the paths. Several forces add up.

strength.description: How far the paths are bent by the forces. Alpha goes along the path, so the strength can change from base to tip.

stiffness.description: How much of the path stays rigid. 0 bends the whole path evenly, 1 keeps the base straight and bends only the tip.

depth.description: On which layers of paths to work, counted from the outermost. 1 is the layer of branches and leaves, higher values reach down to the trunk. Branches always follow the paths they grow on, also on layers that are not bent.
